0.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_DEFAULT_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_000
0.description: Oh, why does nobody want to buy my lovely treasures? And why is my tummy rumbling so? Running a shop of your own sure is tough! However does Rowena manage?
0.translation_description: Perché nessuno vuole comprare le mie adorabili mercanzie? E perché mi brontola lo stomaco? Gestire un negozio tutto tuo è davvero faticoso! Come farà Rowena?

1.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_000
1.description: Welcome, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Here to help me do Menphina's work, I take it? Let's see how many smiles we can put on the children's faces today!
1.translation_description: Ti do il benvenuto, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Sei qui per aiutarmi a compiere l’opera di Menphina, immagino? Vediamo quanti sorrisi riusciremo a regalare ai bambini oggi!

2.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_000
2.description: Welcome back, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I'm happy to say that the children are smiling more and more with each passing day!
2.translation_description: È bello rivederti, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Sono felice di dirti che ogni giorno i bambini sorridono sempre di più!

3.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_000
3.description: Oh, it's <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe's on the verge of making the biggest deal of her life! I <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> succeed. I <hex:021A020203>must<hex:021A020103>! For the children!
3.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe è sul punto di concludere l’affare più importante della sua vita! Io <hex:021A020203>ci riuscirò<hex:021A020103>. Io <hex:021A020203>devo<hex:021A020103> farcela! Per i bambini!

4.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_000
4.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Thanks to you, the children are as happy as Zhloe's ever seen them! If only you could see their beaming faces!
4.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Grazie a te i bambini sono più felici che mai! Se solo potessi vedere i loro sorrisi raggianti!

5.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_000
5.description: Welcome home, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I know this isn't <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> your home, but we've been working together so much lately, you feel like family!
5.translation_description: Che bello, sei di nuovo qui, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! So che non è <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> casa tua, ma ultimamente lavoriamo insieme così spesso che ormai ti considero parte della famiglia!

6.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_000
6.description: Hello there, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe has to say, working with you has been one delightful discovery after the next! What wonders await us today?
6.translation_description: Ciao, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe deve dirtelo: collaborare con te è stata una meravigliosa scoperta dopo l’altra! Chissà quali sorprese ci aspettano oggi!

7.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_020_000
7.description: Welcome, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Working together like this, I feel like I'm getting to know you more and more each day. I hope you're enjoying getting to know me, too!
7.translation_description: Ti do il benvenuto, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Lavorando insieme sento di conoscerti sempre meglio. Spero che anche a te faccia piacere conoscere meglio Zhloe!

8.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_GREETING_ZHLOEALIAPOH_030_000
8.description: So good to see you again, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! With the two of us working together, it won't be long until there's a smile on the face of every child in the realm!
8.translation_description: Che bello rivederti, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Lavorando insieme, non ci vorrà molto prima che ogni bambino del regno possa sorridere!

9.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_TOPMENU_000_000
9.description: What would you like to do?

48.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_TUTORIAL_000_000
48.description: Help Zhloe Aliapoh achieve her goals by delivering collectables. For more information, speak with her and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Learn about custom deliveries<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
48.translation_description: Aiuta Zhloe Aliapoh a raggiungere i suoi obiettivi consegnando oggetti collezionabili. Per saperne di più, parlale e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Informazioni sulle Consegne su Misura<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

59.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_TUTORIAL_001_000
59.description: In making your first successful delivery, you have begun to earn Zhloe's trust.
59.translation_description: Con la tua prima consegna riuscita hai iniziato a guadagnare la fiducia di Zhloe.

60.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_TUTORIAL_001_001
60.description: With each successful delivery, Zhloe will grow more and more satisfied with your efforts. Fill the gauge completely and Zhloe's <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>satisfaction level<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> will increase, giving you the opportunity to learn more about your business partner.
60.translation_description: A ogni consegna riuscita Zhloe sarà sempre più soddisfatta del tuo lavoro. Riempi completamente l’indicatore e il suo <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>livello di soddisfazione<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103> aumenterà, permettendoti di conoscere meglio la tua socia in affari.

61.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_TUTORIAL_001_002
61.description: You can make up to six deliveries in a given week. Deliver the items Zhloe needs, and deliver them often to win the trust and praise of your new business partner!
61.translation_description: Puoi effettuare fino a sei consegne a settimana. Consegna spesso gli oggetti richiesti da Zhloe per guadagnare la fiducia e la riconoscenza della tua nuova socia in affari!

62.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_WEEKLYLIMIT_000_000
62.translation_description: Hai raggiunto il limite settimanale di sei consegne. Potrai ricominciare a effettuare consegne da <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

63.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_000
63.description: With Ishgardians taking a greater and greater interest in foreign nations of late, trinkets and treasures from the Near East are in great demand. This is just what they're looking for!
63.translation_description: Ultimamente gli ishgardiani si interessano sempre più alle nazioni straniere, e i ninnoli e i tesori del Vicino Oriente sono molto richiesti. È proprio ciò che cercano!

64.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_001
64.description: The Coerthas highlands are home to all sorts of treasures of cool, austere beauty. The wealthy patrons of Costa del Sol are sure to pay a good price for something this exotic and enticing!
64.translation_description: Gli altopiani di Coerthas ospitano tesori dall’eleganza fredda e austera. I ricchi mecenati di Costa del Sol pagheranno sicuramente una bella cifra per qualcosa di tanto esotico e allettante!

65.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_002
65.description: Weaponry, alchemical potations, rations...the Admiral needs all the supplies she can get, and this should serve quite nicely!
65.translation_description: Armi, pozioni alchemiche, razioni... L’Ammiraglio ha bisogno di tutte le provviste possibili e questo andrà benissimo!

66.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_003
66.description: A present for the children? How kind of you! The mere sight of the box is sure to fill their hearts with joy and wonder. Why, I suppose it will have the same effect on me!
66.translation_description: Un regalo per i bambini? Che gentile! Solo vedere la scatola riempirà i loro cuori di gioia e meraviglia. A pensarci bene, avrà lo stesso effetto anche su di me!

67.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_004
67.description: More supplies for the orphanage? Zhloe can't thank you enough. Anything you can offer for us is truly, deeply appreciated─by me and the children both!
67.translation_description: Altre provviste per l’orfanotrofio? Zhloe non sa come ringraziarti! Qualunque cosa tu possa offrirci è davvero molto apprezzata, da me e da tutti i bambini!

68.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_000
68.description: This is a form of ancient currency once minted in Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han, said to be a remnant of ancient trade routes long since abandoned. It's sure to strike the fancy of any connoisseur of Near Eastern history.
68.translation_description: Questa è una forma di valuta antica, coniata un tempo a Radz<hex:021F0103>at<hex:021F0103>Han, e si dice che sia ciò che resta di rotte commerciali abbandonate da molto tempo. Farà sicuramente gola a ogni intenditore di storia del Vicino Oriente.

69.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_001
69.description: Ice stalagmites, formed by the dripping of pure cavern waters over long periods of time, are known for their crystal-clear purity. Speaking of which, what's the difference between a stalagmite and a stalactite again? Either way, this is sure to fetch a good price!
69.translation_description: Le stalagmiti di ghiaccio, formate dal gocciolio di acqua pura delle caverne nel corso di lunghi periodi, sono note per la loro limpidezza cristallina. A proposito, qual è la differenza tra una stalagmite e una stalattite? In ogni caso, questa frutterà un bel gruzzolo!

70.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_002
70.description: This moss is an indispensable ingredient in the brewing of dusken draught, which, as we all know, is <hex:021A020203>itself<hex:021A020103> indispensable in...actually, I'm not quite sure. What I <hex:021A020203>am<hex:021A020103> sure about is that the Maelstrom's supplier is willing to pay a premium for it!
70.translation_description: Questo muschio è un ingrediente indispensabile per preparare la pozione del crepuscolo, che, come tutti sappiamo, è <hex:021A020203>a sua volta<hex:021A020103> indispensabile per... in realtà non so bene per cosa. Quel che <hex:021A020203>so<hex:021A020103> per certo è che il fornitore del Maelstrom è disposto a pagarlo profumatamente!

71.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_003
71.description: If it's one thing the children love, it's playing with these little glass balls! When I was struggling to put food on their plates, sometimes they would try to swallow them─that wasn't good. But I'm certain that's a thing of the past now!
71.translation_description: Ai bambini piace da morire giocare con queste biglie di vetro! Quando facevo fatica a mettere del cibo nei loro piatti, a volte cercavano di ingoiarle─e non andava bene. Ma sono certa che ormai sia acqua passata!

72.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_004
72.description: With these seven striking colors, the children will be able to paint anything their little hearts desire! Wouldn't it be sweet if one of them decided to paint a portrait of you or me?
72.translation_description: Con questi sette colori sgargianti i bambini potranno dipingere tutto ciò che desiderano! Non sarebbe dolce se uno di loro facesse un ritratto a te o a me?

73.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_000
73.description: Isn't this one so beautiful? It's said they were originally bred by the Sharlayans for research purposes, then released into the sea─by accident or design, none can say. I must say, it looks quite tasty as well!
73.translation_description: È bellissimo, vero? Si dice che gli Sharlayan li allevassero per scopi di ricerca e poi li liberassero in mare─per errore o di proposito, nessuno lo sa. Devo dire che sembra anche piuttosto gustoso!

74.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_001
74.description: So elegant and limpid, you'd think it was fashioned from solid ice. This is sure to fetch a princely sum from Master Gegeruju!
74.translation_description: È così elegante e limpido che sembra ricavato da un blocco di ghiaccio. Master Gegeruju pagherà sicuramente una somma principesca!

75.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_002
75.description: Another key ingredient of dusken draught, red coral is said to be in short supply around La Noscea of late. Fortunately for us, there's plenty to be found high in the skies!
75.translation_description: Un altro ingrediente indispensabile per la pozione del crepuscolo: si dice che ultimamente i coralli rossi scarseggino a La Noscea. Per fortuna, ce n’è in abbondanza lassù, tra le isole sospese!

76.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_003
76.description: T'kebbe and her friends love these little beauties. By putting two of them together, look─you can even make a little heart!
76.translation_description: T’kebbe e le sue amiche adorano queste piccole meraviglie. Se ne mettiamo due insieme, guarda: formano persino un cuoricino!

77.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_KNOWLEDGE_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_004
77.description: Fried river shrimp are the children's favorite supper treat! Raw, boiled and buttered...but especially fried! I'm quite partial to them myself─it's all I can do to keep myself from eating their share!
77.translation_description: I gamberetti di fiume fritti sono la cena preferita dei bambini! Crudi, bolliti, al burro... ma soprattutto fritti! Piacciono molto anche a me: faccio fatica a non mangiare la loro porzione!

78.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_JUDGEMENT_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_000
78.description: Now, let's take a closer look! Oh, well...this is certainly, um, nice. Yes, I'm sure that someone...somewhere...would take a liking to this. Sometimes, it's the imperfections that give something extra charm. Like how Zhloe's one crooked tooth makes her that much cuter, you know? Just like that!
78.translation_description: Vediamo un po’... Uhm... be’, questo è... carino. Sì, sono certa che da qualche parte ci sia qualcuno a cui potrebbe piacere. A volte sono proprio le imperfezioni a dare un fascino in più. Come il dentino storto di Zhloe, che la rende ancora più carina, sai? Proprio così!

79.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_JUDGEMENT_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_001
79.description: Now, let's take a closer look... Why, this is lovely! My customers will be overjoyed to see something so beautiful! I can't thank you enough, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!
79.translation_description: Vediamo meglio... Ma è meraviglioso! I miei clienti saranno felicissimi di ammirare tanta bellezza! Non so davvero come ringraziarti, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

80.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_JUDGEMENT_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_002
80.description: Now, let's take a closer look... Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, it's absolutely stunning! So stunning that it's a shame I have to sell it! But I will make the ultimate sacrifice─for the children!
80.translation_description: Vediamo meglio... Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, è uno splendore! È così bello che mi dispiace doverlo vendere! Ma farò questo sacrificio─per i bambini!

81.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_JUDGEMENT_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_003
81.description: Let's take a look, now... A present for the children? How terribly thoughtful of you! Thanks to you, this will be one of the happiest days of their lives. I'm sure of it!
81.translation_description: Vediamo un po’... Un regalo per i bambini? Che pensiero gentile! Grazie a te, sarà uno dei giorni più felici della loro vita. Ne sono certa!

82.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_JUDGEMENT_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_004
82.description: Let's see what we have here... More supplies for the orphanage? Oh, thank you ever so much, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe promises she'll put it to good use!
82.translation_description: Vediamo cosa abbiamo qui... Altre provviste per l’orfanotrofio? Oh, grazie di cuore, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe promette che ne farà buon uso!

83.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_FULLBAG_000_000
83.description: Unable to obtain your reward. Your inventory is full.
83.translation_description: Non è stato possibile ottenere la ricompensa. L’inventario è pieno.

84.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_FULLBAG_000_001
84.description: To collect your reward, make room in your inventory and speak with Zhloe Aliapoh once more.
84.translation_description: Per ritirare la ricompensa, fai spazio nell’inventario e parla di nuovo con Zhloe Aliapoh.

85.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_BEFRANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_000_000
85.description: Thanks to you, I've got so many Near Eastern treasures that I barely have space for them all! Fortunately, Zhloe knows some very wealthy individuals who can hardly wait to take them off her hands. Tee hee!
85.translation_description: Grazie a te, ho accumulato così tanti tesori del Vicino Oriente che non so più dove metterli! Per fortuna Zhloe conosce persone molto ricche, pronte a portarmeli via. Eheh!

86.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_BEFRANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_000
86.description: Thanks to your hard work, Zhloe's practically swimming in souvenirs from the highlands! Why, I can just see the smile on Master Gegeruju's face...and the gil flowing freely from his coffers. Tee hee!
86.translation_description: Grazie al tuo aiuto, Zhloe è sommersa di souvenir degli altopiani! Mi immagino già il sorriso di Master Gegeruju... e i gil che scorrono a fiumi dalle sue casse. Eheh!

87.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_BEFRANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_000
87.description: Zhloe is ever, ever so grateful to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Thanks to you, the Maelstrom will have enough materiel to wage a thousand wars! I can just hear the sound of the cannons a-firing and hulls a-cracking! Did I mention that I wanted to be a pirate when I was small?
87.translation_description: Zhloe ti è infinitamente grata, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Grazie a te, il Maelstrom avrà abbastanza materiale bellico per combattere mille guerre! Mi sembra già di sentire i cannoni tuonare e gli scafi scricchiolare! Ho mai detto che da piccola volevo diventare una pirata?

88.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_BEFRANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_000
88.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, how can Zhloe ever thank you? So many gifts, and every last one of them straight from the heart! The children will know joy and happiness beyond their wildest dreams!
88.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, come farà mai Zhloe a ringraziarti? Sono così tanti i doni e ognuno viene dal cuore! I bambini conosceranno una gioia e una felicità che vanno oltre ogni loro sogno!

89.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_000
89.description: I'm happy to say that your Near Eastern treasures have found no end of fans among the Ishgardian aristocracy!
89.translation_description: Sono felice di dirti che i tuoi tesori del Vicino Oriente hanno riscosso un enorme successo tra l’aristocrazia ishgardiana!

90.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_001
90.description: Why, with only the funds that have poured in thus far, I can safely say that Menphina's Arms will stay welcomingly wide open for...well, at least the next couple of days or so!
90.translation_description: Con i gil raccolti finora, le Braccia di Menphina potranno continuare ad accogliere tutti a braccia spalancate... beh, direi almeno per un altro paio di giorni!

91.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_002
91.description: But is Zhloe going to rest on her laurels? Perish the thought! Not when there are countless children still yearning for warmth and love! I can count on you...can't I, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?
91.translation_description: Ma Zhloe si adagerà sugli allori? Non sia mai! Ci sono ancora tanti bambini che hanno bisogno di calore e affetto! Posso contare su di te... vero, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

92.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_003
92.description: Oh, thank you! This calls for a celebration! Why, yes, I think I'll treat myself to that last bite of pineapple pudding I've been saving since last week!
92.translation_description: Oh, grazie! Questo merita una festa! Anzi, mi concederò quell’ultimo boccone di budino all’ananas che tengo da parte dalla settimana scorsa!

93.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_001_004
93.description: If anyone deserves it, it's you, Miss Zhloe! You're always working so hard to put food on our plates.
93.translation_description: Se qualcuno lo merita, sei proprio tu, signorina Zhloe! Ti dai sempre tanto da fare per far sì che non ci manchi il cibo.

95.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_006
95.description: This is <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, a famous adventurer. <hex:020810E905FF065368652773FF054865277303> the one who's helping Miss Zhloe turn her trading business around!
95.translation_description: Questo è <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, un avventuriero famoso. <hex:02080BE905FF03C388FF03C38803> la persona che sta aiutando la signorina Zhloe a risollevare i suoi affari!

96.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_001_007
96.description: You're an adventurer, <hex:020811E905FF054D697373FF074D697374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? My mummy and daddy are adventurers, too! I wish you could meet them...
96.translation_description: Ma tu sei un avventuriero, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Anche i miei genitori sono avventurieri! Vorrei tanto che potessi conoscerli...

97.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_001_008
97.description: Mummy and Daddy are the strongest adventurers I've ever seen! They're always keeping the people of Idyllshire safe from nasty monsters...or at least they were.
97.translation_description: Mamma e papà sono gli avventurieri più forti che conosca! Proteggono sempre gli abitanti di Borgopace dai mostri cattivi... o almeno lo facevano.

98.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_001_009
98.description: The other day, they went off to hunt something called a “leet mark.” They said they'd be home by sundown, but I haven't seen them since. Miss Zhloe says they probably just got lost. Anyway, I was so scared and lonely all by myself...but then I met Miss Zhloe!
98.translation_description: L’altro giorno sono andati a caccia di un cosiddetto «marchio élite». Hanno detto che sarebbero tornati entro il tramonto, ma non li ho più visti. La signorina Zhloe dice che probabilmente si sono persi. Ero così spaventata e sola... ma poi ho conosciuto lei!

99.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_001_010
99.description: She's been so nice to me, just like a big sister! Sometimes she forgets to unlock the door, or feed us, but I know that's just because she's busy. Right, Miss Zhloe? I just met you, <hex:020811E905FF054D697373FF074D697374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, but I like you, too!
99.translation_description: È così gentile con me, proprio come una sorella maggiore! A volte si dimentica di chiudere la porta o di darci da mangiare, ma so che è solo perché è impegnata. Vero, signorina Zhloe? Ti ho appena conosciuto, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, ma piaci anche a me!

100.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_001_011
100.description: Anyway, I'm going to go now. My best friend promised she'd tell me a story about dragons, and I just <hex:021A020203>love<hex:021A020103> dragons! See you later, Miss Zhloe, <hex:020811E905FF054D697373FF074D697374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>.
100.translation_description: Comunque, vado. La mia migliore amica ha promesso di raccontarmi una storia sui draghi, e io <hex:021A020203>adoro<hex:021A020103> i draghi! A più tardi, signorina Zhloe, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

101.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_012
101.description: That's T'kebbe. Just between the two of us, search parties have been scouring the land for any sign of her parents, but...nothing. I know I shouldn't get the poor girl's hopes up, but I simply haven't the heart to tell her the truth. Besides, Menphina may still work a miracle yet...
101.translation_description: È T’kebbe. Tra noi, le squadre di ricerca stanno perlustrando la regione da cima a fondo in cerca dei suoi genitori, ma... niente. So che non dovrei illudere quella povera bambina, ma non ho il coraggio di dirle la verità. E poi Menphina potrebbe ancora compiere un miracolo...

102.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_013
102.description: The day after her parents disappeared, poor little T'kebbe rushed out from her home to the city gates. She waited there day and night, in the beating rain and blustery wind, just so she could greet her dear mother and father with a smile the very moment they returned home.
102.translation_description: Il giorno dopo la scomparsa dei suoi genitori, la piccola T’kebbe corse fuori di casa e raggiunse le porte della città. Rimase lì giorno e notte, sotto la pioggia battente e il vento impetuoso, pronta ad accogliere con un sorriso la mamma e il papà nel momento del loro ritorno.

103.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_014
103.description: When I found her, she was sniffling and shivering in the cold...and that was when my inspiration struck. I would start an orphanage, right here in Idyllshire, and take in all the poor children like T'kebbe who were crying out for a gentle helping hand.
103.translation_description: Quando la trovai, tremava e singhiozzava per il freddo... e fu allora che mi venne un’idea. Avrei aperto un orfanotrofio proprio qui a Borgopace e accolto tutti i bambini come T’kebbe, bisognosi di una mano gentile.

104.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_015
104.description: And that's why I must keep to the task! Menphina's Arms must spread wider and wider, that no child need know such pain and loneliness ever again! <rumble> <rumble> Is it supper time yet?
104.translation_description: Ecco perché devo portare avanti la mia missione! Le Braccia di Menphina devono accogliere sempre più bambini, così nessuno di loro dovrà mai più conoscere tanto dolore e solitudine! <brontolio> <brontolio> È già ora di cena?

105.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_000
105.description: The souvenirs you brought back from Coerthas have been selling like...er, something that sells a whole lot! Master Gegeruju and his friends at Costa del Sol say that just gazing at them is as refreshing as a cool breeze on a hot summer's day!
105.translation_description: I souvenir che mi hai portato da Coerthas vanno a ruba... ehm, diciamo che si vendono davvero benissimo! Master Gegeruju e i suoi amici di Costa del Sol dicono che basta guardarli per sentirsi rinfrescati da una brezza fresca in una calda giornata estiva!

106.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_001
106.description: Why, the gil's been pouring in day and night, left and right! But that's not all! Now that our finances are under control, I can finally buy the books and writing implements I've had my eyes on for so long!
106.translation_description: I gil arrivano a fiumi, giorno e notte, da ogni parte! E non è tutto! Ora che le finanze sono sotto controllo, posso finalmente comprare i libri e gli strumenti per scrivere che desideravo da tanto!

107.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_002
107.description: After all, Zhloe can't very well watch over them forever, can she now? I must help them cultivate their minds, that one day they can strike out and earn their keep on their own. Zhloe was never cut out to be more than a humble merchant, but their future is just full of possibilities. I can't let them down!
107.translation_description: Dopotutto, non potrò occuparmi di loro per sempre, no? Devo aiutarli a coltivare la mente, così un giorno potranno cavarsela da soli. Zhloe non è fatta per essere altro che una modesta mercante, ma il loro futuro è pieno di possibilità. Non posso deluderli!

108.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_003
108.description: And to think that not long ago, I was worried that I wouldn't be able to pay next month's rent. Just look at how far we've come! And it's all thanks to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe thanks you from the very bottom of her heart!
108.translation_description: E pensare che poco tempo fa temevo di non riuscire a pagare l’affitto del mese prossimo! Guarda quanta strada abbiamo fatto! Ed è tutto merito tuo, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Zhloe ti ringrazia dal profondo del cuore!

109.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_004
109.description: Today, I think I'll treat myself to a fresh bowl of pineapple pudding! Freshly made three days ago, that is─have to make it last, you know. Anyhow, I know you're doing the hard work, but even I deserve that much, wouldn't you say?
109.translation_description: Oggi mi concederò una scodella di budino all’ananas fresco! Preparato tre giorni fa, s’intende─devo farlo durare, sai. Lo so che sei tu a faticare, ma anche io merito un premio, non trovi?

110.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_005
110.description: Oh, thank you! The last bowl I had was left over from last month's batch, and it was somewhat lacking in the smoothness one generally associates with pudding. Why, I almost thought I'd crack a tooth!
110.translation_description: Oh, grazie! Il budino dell’ultima scodella che ho mangiato proveniva dal lotto del mese scorso e gli mancava quella consistenza vellutata che di solito si associa al budino. Per poco non mi spaccavo un dente!

111.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_006
111.description: Not that I <hex:021A020203>actually<hex:021A020103> cracked one, of course. See for yourself─Zhloe's smile is as cute as ever! That one tooth that's slightly out of place only adds to the charm! At least, that's what Rowena always told me. Don't you think so, too?
111.translation_description: Non è che me ne sia <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> rotto uno, sia chiaro! Guarda tu stesso: il sorriso di Zhloe è adorabile come sempre! Quel dentino leggermente storto aggiunge ancora più fascino! Almeno, è quello che Rowena mi ha sempre detto. Non trovi?

112.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_007
112.description: Oh, you're really too sweet! I'll let you in on a secret. From leftover pudding to stale flatbread─no matter how hard a piece of food gets, you can always soften it up by soaking it in hot water!
112.translation_description: Oh, sei davvero troppo gentile! Ti svelo un segreto: dal budino avanzato al pane raffermo, non importa quanto un cibo diventi duro: basta lasciarlo nell’acqua calda e si ammorbidisce sempre!

113.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_008
113.description: Of course, it doesn't taste as good then, but at least it's easy on the jaw. And we all have to make sacrifices, right? At least, that's what I tell the children when all I have for their supper is day-old porridge.
113.translation_description: Certo, poi non è altrettanto buono, ma almeno non si fa fatica a masticarlo. E tutti dobbiamo fare qualche sacrificio, no? È quello che dico ai bambini quando per cena ho solo porridge del giorno prima.

114.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_000
114.description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You'll be happy to know that Zhloe's instincts were right on the mark once more!
114.translation_description: <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Ti farà piacere sapere che l’istinto di Zhloe aveva ancora una volta colto nel segno!

115.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_001
115.description: My contact in Limsa tells me that the materiel you collected for the Maelstrom was─and I quote─“a bloody godssend.” Those were the Admiral's own words! Can you believe it? Zhloe still can't believe it! Every piece has been sold off, and at prices that have our coffers overflowing like never before!
115.translation_description: Una mia conoscenza a Limsa mi ha detto che il materiale bellico che hai raccolto per il Maelstrom è stato─e cito testualmente─«una santa manna dal cielo»! Sono parole dell’Ammiraglio in persona! Ci credi? Zhloe non riesce ancora a capacitarsene! È stato venduto ogni pezzo, a prezzi tali da riempire le nostre casse come mai prima!

116.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_002
116.description: Now I can finally provide the children with the life they deserve. One square meal a day to accompany their usual porridge! Blankets and bedding free of mold and moth holes! Shoes with...<gasp>...actual soles!
116.translation_description: Ora posso finalmente dare ai bambini la vita che meritano. Un pasto completo al giorno, oltre al solito porridge! Coperte e lenzuola senza muffa né buchi di tarme! E scarpe con... <ansima>... suole vere!

117.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_003
117.description: And finally─finally!─Zhloe can treat herself to a fresh bowl of pineapple pudding every other day!
117.translation_description: E finalmente─finalmente!─Zhloe potrà concedersi una scodella di budino all’ananas fresco a giorni alterni!

120.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_A1_000_002
120.description: What will you eat the other day?
120.translation_description: E negli altri giorni che mangerai?

121.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_010
121.description: Perish the thought, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! How could I even <hex:021A020203>think<hex:021A020103> of treating myself to such luxuries when there are children starving in the streets as we speak!? Menphina would never forgive me!
121.translation_description: Ma neanche per sogno, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Come potrei anche solo <hex:021A020203>pensare<hex:021A020103> di concedermi simili lussi mentre proprio ora ci sono bambini che muoiono di fame per strada!? Menphina non me lo perdonerebbe mai!

122.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_020
122.description: Why...nothing, of course. But don't worry! I just close my eyes, savor the smells wafting in from Adkiragh's kitchen, and chomp my teeth together. If I try <hex:021A020203>really<hex:021A020103> hard, I can almost convince myself that I'm dining on a full-course meal!
122.translation_description: Ma niente, naturalmente. Non preoccuparti! Mi basta chiudere gli occhi, assaporare il profumo che arriva dalla cucina di Adkiragh e far schioccare i denti. Se ci provo <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103>, riesco quasi a convincermi di stare gustando un pasto completo!

123.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_004_000
123.description: <hex:020811E905FF054D697373FF074D697374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Miss Zhloe! Thank you so, so, <hex:021A020203>so<hex:021A020103> much for the presents! This is my best nameday since the time Mummy and Daddy got me a wind-up moogle!
123.translation_description: <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Signorina Zhloe! Grazie, grazie, <hex:021A020203>grazie<hex:021A020103> di cuore per i regali! È il mio giorno del nome più bello da quando mamma e papà mi regalarono un moguri a molla!

124.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_004_001
124.description: My best friend was so happy, too! She said it's the second happiest day of her life, after the day she saw a real, live dragon! Did I tell you how much I love dragons?
124.translation_description: Anche la mia migliore amica era felicissima! Ha detto che è stato il secondo giorno più bello della sua vita, dopo quello in cui ha visto un drago vero, in carne e ossa! Ti ho già detto quanto adoro i draghi?

125.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_002
125.description: You certainly did, T'kebbe! And guess what? Zhloe loves dragons, too! But I'm glad your nameday was a happy one. Just wait and see what I have planned for you next year!
125.translation_description: T’kebbe, lo sapevi? Anche a Zhloe piacciono moltissimo i draghi! Ma sono felice che il tuo giorno del nome sia stato così bello. Aspetta e vedrai cosa ti ho preparato per l’anno prossimo!

126.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_KHLOEALIAPOH_004_003
126.description: Hi Zhloe! I just came to say hi─which I guess I just did! Are you working hard? Khloe's working hard, too!
126.translation_description: Ciao, Zhloe! Sono venuta solo per salutarti─e direi che l’ho appena fatto! Stai lavorando sodo? Anche Khloe si dà da fare!

127.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_KHLOEALIAPOH_004_004
127.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! What are you─wait, I know! You're working with Zhloe! Zhloe told me she had a new partner, but I didn't know it was you! Until now, I mean!
127.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Che ci fai qui? Aspetta, ho capito! Lavori con Zhloe! Zhloe mi ha detto che aveva una nuova socia, ma non sapevo che fossi tu! Cioè, finché non ti ho visto!

128.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_KHLOEALIAPOH_004_005
128.description: Who's this nice-looking <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03>? Is <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> the one helping you with your business? Khloe wishes she had an adventurer helping her, too!
128.translation_description: Chi è <hex:02082DE905FF157175657374612062656C6C61207369676E6F7261FF1371756573746F2062656C207369676E6F726503>? È <hex:02081BE905FF0B6C6120706572736F6E61FF0B6C6120706572736F6E6103> che ti aiuta con i tuoi affari? Anche Khloe vorrebbe un avventuriero che l’aiutasse!

129.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_006
129.description: <hex:02080CE905FF04536865FF03486503> sure is! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> here has been a godssend─ever since <hex:02080CE905FF04736865FF03686503> showed up, the gil's been flowing in virtually nonstop!
129.translation_description: <hex:020821E905FF0E436572746F206368652073C3ACFF0E436572746F206368652073C3AC03>! <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203> è una vera manna dal cielo─da quando <hex:02081DE905FF0CC3A8206172726976617461FF0CC3A820617272697661746F03>, i gil arrivano praticamente senza sosta!

130.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_KHLOEALIAPOH_004_007
130.description: That's wonderful, Zhloe! Oh, oh...! Khloe almost forgot! T'kebbe, guess what? Khloe has a new story for you! I think it might be my best ever! You want to hear it, don't you?
130.translation_description: Che bello, Zhloe! Oh, oh... Khloe stava quasi per dimenticarsene! T’kebbe, indovina? Ho una nuova storia per te! Credo che sia la migliore che abbia mai inventato! Vuoi sentirla, vero?

131.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_004_008
131.description: Yay! I sure do! Does it have dragons in it? Please say it does!
131.translation_description: Sì! Eccome! Ci sono i draghi? Ti prego, dimmi di sì!

132.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_004_009
132.description: Anyway, we'll be going now. See you around, <hex:020811E905FF054D697373FF074D697374657203> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! And I know you're really, really busy, Miss Zhloe...but please try not to forget our supper tonight, okay?
132.translation_description: Comunque, ora andiamo. A presto, <hex:020817E905FF0A7369676E6F72696E61FF087369676E6F726503> <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! E so che sei davvero molto impegnata, signorina Zhloe... ma cerca di non dimenticarti la nostra cena di stasera, va bene?

133.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_020
133.description: So <hex:021A020203>you're<hex:021A020103> one of the adventurers who's been sharing your tales with my little sister. No wonder her stories have been so exciting of late!
133.translation_description: Quindi <hex:021A020203>sei<hex:021A020103> uno degli avventurieri che raccontano storie alla mia sorellina. Ecco perché ultimamente sono così avvincenti!

134.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_030
134.description: That was my little sister, Khloe. She just loves telling stories!
134.translation_description: Quella era mia sorellina, Khloe. Adora raccontare storie!

135.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_050
135.description: She's still just a child, but no matter how hard things get, that smile never leaves her face. Even though I know she's lonely, what with her sister always working.
135.translation_description: È ancora una bambina, ma per quanto la vita sia dura, non perde mai il sorriso. So che si sente sola, visto che sua sorella lavora sempre.

136.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_051
136.description: Now that we're turning a profit and Menphina's Arms is going strong, I can finally spend more time with her. I'm sure she can't wait to tell me her latest stories, and I can't wait to hear them!
136.translation_description: Ora che siamo in attivo e le Braccia di Menphina vanno a gonfie vele, posso finalmente passare più tempo con lei. Sono sicura che non vede l’ora di raccontarmi le sue ultime storie, e io non vedo l’ora di ascoltarle!

137.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_052
137.description: But that doesn't mean Zhloe's closing up shop─not for a second! We may be better off than ever before, but there's always more to be done─for the children, of course. You'll still lend me a helping hand from time to time, won't you?
137.translation_description: Ma questo non significa che Zhloe chiuderà il negozio─neanche per un secondo! Ora stiamo meglio che mai, ma c’è sempre qualcosa da fare─per i bambini, naturalmente. Mi darai ancora una mano ogni tanto, vero?

138.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_053
138.description: Oh, thank you ever so much, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Wherever would Zhloe be if it weren't for you? Probably out on the streets, shivering, with nary a bowl of pineapple pudding to be had! Mmm, pineapples...
138.translation_description: Oh, grazie di cuore, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Dove sarebbe Zhloe senza di te? Probabilmente in strada, al freddo e senza nemmeno una scodella di budino all’ananas! Mmm, ananas...

139.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_100
139.description: Thanks to you, we're doing better than we were─at least Zhloe's paying the rent, now!─but I'm afraid to say Menphina's Arms is still a long way from achieving true financial stability.
139.translation_description: Grazie a te, le cose vanno meglio di prima─almeno Zhloe ora riesce a pagare l’affitto!─ma le Braccia di Menphina sono ancora lontane da una vera stabilità finanziaria.

140.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_101
140.description: So Zhloe got to thinking: perhaps we've been doing ourselves a disservice by limiting our dealings to the Ishgardian nobility─no matter how wealthy and generous they might be.
140.translation_description: Così Zhloe ha iniziato a pensare che forse è stato un errore limitare i nostri affari alla nobiltà ishgardiana, per quanto ricca e generosa possa essere.

141.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_102
141.description: That's why Zhloe's decided to look the realm over, and look <hex:021A020203>big<hex:021A020103>! I'm talking about consortiums, cooperatives, and...conspiracies? Commiserations? That doesn't sound right... Anyway! What I'm trying to say is, I've found a promising new client: Master Gegeruju of Gegeruju Shipping!
141.translation_description: Ecco perché Zhloe ha deciso di guardarsi intorno per tutto il reame e puntare <hex:021A020203>in alto<hex:021A020103>! Parlo di consorzi, cooperative e... complotti? Condoglianze? No, non suona giusto... Comunque! Ho trovato un cliente promettente: Master Gegeruju della compagnia di spedizioni Gegeruju!

142.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_103
142.description: Have you been to his resort at Costa del Sol, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? They say the sun shines bright on waters clear, every day of every year! Tee hee! That rhymed, didn't it?
142.translation_description: Hai mai visitato il suo resort a Costa del Sol, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Dicono che lì il sole splenda su acque cristalline, senza mai avere fine! Eheh! Hai visto? Ho fatto una rima!

143.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_104
143.description: Anyway, I had an idea! What sort of rare trinkets and treasures do you think might tickle the fancy of those who live in a world of endless summer?
143.translation_description: Comunque, mi è venuta un’idea! Quali ninnoli e tesori rari potrebbero stuzzicare la fantasia di chi vive in un’estate senza fine?

144.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_105
144.description: If you're thinking “cool and refreshing relics from the bleak, blustery highlands of Coerthas,” then I guess great minds think alike! Yes, this is the perfect opportunity to build upon the foundation we've laid! What do you say, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Are you with me?
144.translation_description: Se stai pensando a «reliquie fresche e rinfrescanti dagli altopiani cupi e ventosi di Coerthas», allora la pensiamo proprio allo stesso modo! Questa è l’occasione perfetta per costruire su quanto abbiamo già realizzato! Che ne dici, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Ci stai?

145.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_100
145.description: Oh, but how far Menphina's Arms has come! From “teetering on the brink of bankruptcy” to “clinging oh-so-desperately to life,” we now find ourselves <hex:021A020203>this<hex:021A020103> close to achieving our dream of actual stability! And it's all thanks to you! And me. And our clients, of course. And the children, too! What were we talking about, again?
145.translation_description: Oh, quanta strada hanno fatto le Braccia di Menphina! Da «sull’orlo della bancarotta» a «aggrappate disperatamente alla vita», ora siamo <hex:021A020203>così<hex:021A020103> vicini a realizzare il sogno di una vera stabilità! Ed è tutto merito tuo! E mio. E dei nostri clienti, certo. E anche dei bambini! Di che stavamo parlando, già?

146.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_101
146.description: Oh, that's right! Zhloe's set her sights higher and higher in search of her biggest client yet! You'll never guess who it is!
146.translation_description: Ah, giusto! Zhloe punta sempre più in alto, alla ricerca del suo cliente più importante di sempre! Non indovinerai mai chi è!

147.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_102
147.description: I'll give you a hint: what begins with a “mmm” sound and rhymes with “aelstrom?” Give up? I'll tell you: the Maelstrom!
147.translation_description: Ti do un indizio: comincia con una «M» e fa rima con «aelstrom». Hai rinunciato? Te lo dico io: Maelstrom!

148.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_103
148.description: A kind regular here at the Hard Place told me that the Admiral's planning to hold a massive war game of sorts. Doesn't that sound fun? And kind of scary. But fun! Anyhow, the word is they're looking for all the equipment they can get their hands on! Cannons, cannonballs...er, more cannons? I have the list around here somewhere...
148.translation_description: Un cliente abituale molto gentile dell'Incudine mi ha detto che l’Ammiraglio sta organizzando una specie di gigantesca esercitazione militare. Non sembra divertente? E un po’ spaventosa. Ma divertente! A quanto pare cercano tutto l’equipaggiamento possibile: cannoni, palle di cannone... ehm, altri cannoni? Ho la lista da qualche parte...

149.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_104
149.description: Anyhow, I'm sure you can see where this is going. If you could procure for me a healthy stock of top-of-the-line naval materiel, I can guarantee you we'll be positively swimming in gil! But hopefully not drowning. Did Zhloe mention that she can't swim?
149.translation_description: Comunque, credo tu abbia capito dove voglio arrivare. Se riuscissi a procurarmi una buona scorta di materiale navale di primissima qualità, ti assicuro che nuoteremmo nei gil! Speriamo di non affogare, s’intende. Zhloe ti ha mai detto che non sa nuotare?

150.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_105
150.description: But where were we? Oh, of course! I've written up a brand-new register of items for you to procure. You'll take a look, won't you? Remember, it's not just Zhloe who's counting on you─we must think of the children!
150.translation_description: Dov’eravamo rimaste? Ah, certo! Ho preparato un nuovo elenco di oggetti da procurare. Gli darai un’occhiata, vero? Ricorda: non è solo Zhloe a contare su di te─dobbiamo pensare ai bambini!

151.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_100
151.description: To think Zhloe would live to see the day when Menphina's Arms was finally free of debt! Not that I thought I'd actually <hex:021A020203>die<hex:021A020103>, of course. At least, not for a while. I mean, we're all going to die one day, right?
151.translation_description: Chi l’avrebbe mai detto: le Braccia di Menphina sono finalmente libere dai debiti! Non che pensassi di <hex:021A020203>morire<hex:021A020103>, naturalmente. Almeno, non tanto presto. In fondo, moriremo tutti un giorno, no?

152.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_101
152.description: Oh, dear! That conversation took a depressing turn. What I meant to say is, thank you oh so much for all you've done! Thanks to you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, business is thriving, and Zhloe can finally keep Menphina's Arms running on her own!
152.translation_description: Oh, cielo! La conversazione ha preso una piega deprimente. Volevo solo ringraziarti di cuore per tutto quello che hai fatto! Grazie a te, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, gli affari vanno a gonfie vele e Zhloe può finalmente mandare avanti da sola le Braccia di Menphina!

153.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_102
153.description: Oh, T'kebbe! What brings you out here? Is something the matter? Oh, no! Did Zhloe forget your <hex:02083BE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF07737570706572FF0A627265616B6661737403FF18020814E3E90C12FF066C756E6368FF077375707065720303> again?
153.translation_description: Oh, T’kebbe! Che ci fai qui? C’è qualcosa che non va? Oh, no! Zhloe si è dimenticata di prepararti la <hex:020838E3E90C0DFF1A020816E3E90C05FF0563656E61FF0A636F6C617A696F6E6503FF17020813E3E90C12FF077072616E7A6FFF0563656E610303> di nuovo?

154.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_003_103
154.description: <sniffle> N-No, Miss Zhloe. It's...<sniffle>...it's my friend. I told her my nameday was coming, and...she started crying. She said...<sniffle>...she doesn't know when her nameday is. Then I started crying, too.
154.translation_description: <singhiozza> N-No, signorina Zhloe. È... <singhiozza>... è per la mia amica. Le ho detto che si avvicinava il mio giorno del nome e... si è messa a piangere. Ha detto... <singhiozza>... che non sa quando sia il suo. E così ho iniziato a piangere anch’io.

155.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_003_104
155.description: When I first came to Menphina's Arms, I cried in my bed every night. I tried to smile in front of you, Miss Zhloe, but...but...but deep down, I knew that Mummy and Daddy were never coming back.
155.translation_description: Quando sono arrivata alle Braccia di Menphina, piangevo ogni notte nel letto. Cercavo di sorridere davanti a te, signorina Zhloe, ma... ma... in fondo sapevo che mamma e papà non sarebbero più tornati.

156.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_003_105
156.description: But Miss Zhloe was so nice to me, and...and...Khloe would always cheer me up with stories about dragons, and...<sniffle>...before I knew it, I wasn't crying anymore.
156.translation_description: Ma la signorina Zhloe è stata così gentile con me e... e... Khloe riusciva sempre a tirarmi su con le sue storie sui draghi e... <singhiozza>... senza accorgermene, avevo smesso di piangere.

157.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_003_106
157.description: And so...so...I want to do for her what Khloe and Miss Zhloe did for me. But what can I do, Miss Zhloe? If only I could give her <hex:021A020203>my<hex:021A020103> nameday, I would, but...
157.translation_description: E allora... allora... voglio fare per lei quello che Khloe e la signorina Zhloe hanno fatto per me. Ma che cosa posso fare, signorina Zhloe? Se solo potessi regalarle <hex:021A020203>il mio<hex:021A020103> giorno del nome, lo farei, ma...

158.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_107
158.description: Yes, if only...wait! T'kebbe, you're a genius! Don't you see? We'll just declare your nameday the day of <hex:021A020203>all<hex:021A020103> your friends who don't have a nameday of their own! We can all celebrate together, and none of you will have to feel alone! That's such a great idea, I wish I'd thought of it! Or wait...did I?
158.translation_description: Sì, se solo... aspetta! T’kebbe, sei un genio! Non capisci? Dichiariamo che il tuo giorno del nome sarà anche quello di <hex:021A020203>tutti<hex:021A020103> i tuoi amici che non ne hanno uno! Così potremo festeggiare insieme e nessuno di voi si sentirà solo! È un’idea fantastica, avrei voluto pensarci io! Anzi... forse ci avevo pensato?

159.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_TKEBBE_003_108
159.description: Oh, Miss Zhloe! Can we really? It would make her so, so happy!
159.translation_description: Oh, signorina Zhloe! Possiamo davvero farlo? La renderemmo così, così felice!

160.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_109
160.description: Of course we can! But we're going to need presents! And not just any presents! Presents so delightful that these poor boys and girls will be able to forget...<sniffle>...if only for a day...<sniffle>...all the pain and...<sniffle>...suffering they've endured in their... I'm sorry, I seem to have something in my...<sniffle>...eye...
160.translation_description: Certo che sì! Ma ci serviranno dei regali! E non regali qualsiasi: dovranno essere così meravigliosi da far dimenticare a questi poveri bambini... <singhiozza>... almeno per un giorno... <singhiozza>... tutto il dolore e... <singhiozza>... le sofferenze che hanno patito... Scusate, dev’essermi entrato qualcosa... <singhiozza>... nell’occhio...

161.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_110
161.description: Get yourself together, Zhloe! Standing around here sniffling isn't going to get anything done! Well now, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, I think you know what we have to do. Are you ready to get collecting?
161.translation_description: Forza, Zhloe! Restare qui a singhiozzare non serve a niente! Bene, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>, sai già cosa dobbiamo fare. Ti va di metterti a raccogliere?

162.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_100
162.description: ...Ahem! And with that, I would like to announce our latest client. But before I do, I must warn you─she's quite a demanding one!
162.translation_description: ...Ehm! Con questo, vorrei presentare il nostro ultimo cliente. Ma devo avvertirti: è piuttosto esigente!

163.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_101
163.description: Our latest client is none other than...me! Tee hee! Weren't expecting that, were you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? Why, I think I even surprised myself!
163.translation_description: La nostra ultima cliente sono... io! Eheh! Non te l’aspettavi, vero, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>? A quanto pare sono riuscita a sorprendere persino me stessa!

164.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_LCUT_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_102
164.description: Thanks to all you've done, Menphina's Arms have spread wider than I ever dreamed! But there are just a few more things I need to <hex:021A020203>truly<hex:021A020103> make my orphanage all I've ever dreamed. I can count on you, can't I?
164.translation_description: Grazie a tutto quello che hai fatto, le Braccia di Menphina si sono estese ben oltre i miei sogni! Ma mi mancano ancora alcune cose per trasformare <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> il mio orfanotrofio in ciò che ho sempre sognato. Posso contare su di te, vero?

165.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUPINFO_000_000
165.description: Zhloe Aliapoh is pleased with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Friend to the Orphanage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
165.translation_description: Zhloe Aliapoh è soddisfatta del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Amico dell’Orfanotrofio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

166.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUPINFO_000_001
166.description: Zhloe Aliapoh is delighted with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Patron of the Orphanage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
166.translation_description: Zhloe Aliapoh è entusiasta del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Benefattore dell’Orfanotrofio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

167.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUPINFO_000_002
167.description: Zhloe Aliapoh is overjoyed with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Savior of the Orphanage<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
167.translation_description: Zhloe Aliapoh è felicissima del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera un <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Salvatore dell’Orfanotrofio<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

168.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUPINFO_000_003
168.description: Zhloe Aliapoh could not be happier with your efforts. She now considers you a <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Part of the Family<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!
168.translation_description: Zhloe Aliapoh è felicissima del tuo impegno. Ora ti considera <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Parte della famiglia<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>!

169.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUPINFO_001_001
169.description: And yet there is still much work to be done before the finances of Menphina's Arms are stable. To that end, Zhloe Aliapoh has a new favor to ask of you...
169.translation_description: Eppure c’è ancora molto da fare prima che le finanze delle Braccia di Menphina siano stabili. Per questo Zhloe ha un nuovo favore da chiederti...

170.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUPINFO_001_002
170.description: Through your efforts, the finances of Menphina's Arms are now stable. It seems, however, that Zhloe has a different sort of favor to ask of you...
170.translation_description: Grazie a te, le finanze delle Braccia di Menphina sono finalmente stabili. Pare però che Zhloe voglia chiederti un favore di tutt’altro genere...

171.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_AFTRANKUP_000_001
171.description: The Custom Deliveries list for Zhloe Aliapoh has been updated. To view the new list, speak with Zhloe and select <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
171.translation_description: L’elenco delle Consegne su Misura di Zhloe Aliapoh è stato aggiornato. Per consultare il nuovo elenco, parla con Zhloe e seleziona <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Effettua una consegna<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

172.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_AFTRANKUP_001_001
172.description: Future requests will be selected at random from all those you have seen thus far, with the list refreshed once a week (Earth time).
172.translation_description: Le richieste future verranno selezionate a caso tra quelle che hai già visto. L’elenco si aggiornerà una volta a settimana (ora terrestre).

173.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_AFTRANKUP_001_002
173.description: You may review the items currently in demand at any time by speaking with Zhloe and selecting <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Make a delivery<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.
173.translation_description: Puoi consultare in qualsiasi momento gli oggetti richiesti parlando con Zhloe e selezionando <hex:024804F201F403><hex:024904F201F503>Effettua una consegna<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103>.

174.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_AFTRANKUP_001_003
174.description: Note that orphanage donations, rainbow pigment, and river shrimp will earn you particularly handsome rewards. Whenever they make an appearance, the effort to procure them will be worth your while.
174.translation_description: Le donazioni per l’orfanotrofio, i pigmenti arcobaleno e i gamberetti di fiume fruttano ricompense particolarmente generose. Quando compaiono tra le richieste, vale la pena impegnarsi per procurarseli.

175.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_000
175.description: Why, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You've been working your tail off this week, haven't you? Speaking of tails, I really wish the orphan boys would stop pulling mine. Don't they realize how much that hurts?
175.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Questa settimana ti sei dato un gran daffare, vero? A proposito di code, vorrei che i maschietti dell’orfanotrofio smettessero di tirarmi la mia. Non si rendono conto di quanto faccia male?

176.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_001_001
176.description: Anyway, I think you've earned yourself a much-needed rest. Don't go too far, though─Zhloe's counting on you to help keep Menphina's Arms going strong!
176.translation_description: Non allontanarti troppo, però─Zhloe conta su di te per tenere in piedi le Braccia di Menphina!

177.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_000
177.description: Working as hard as ever, I see! Wherever would Zhloe be without you? Out on the street eating stale flatbread and month-old pineapple pudding, that's where!
177.translation_description: Ancora al lavoro, eh? Dove sarebbe Zhloe senza di te? Per strada, a mangiare pane raffermo e budino all’ananas di un mese, ecco dove!

178.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_002_001
178.description: Still, don't forget to give yourself a rest from time to time! Can I interest you in a bowl of pineapple pudding? <sniff> <sniff> I don't <hex:021A020203>think<hex:021A020103> it's rotten yet.
178.translation_description: Eppure, ricordati di riposarti ogni tanto! Ti andrebbe una scodella di budino all’ananas? <annusa> <annusa> Non <hex:021A020203>credo<hex:021A020103> sia ancora andato a male.

179.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_000
179.description: Phew! We outdid ourselves this week, didn't we, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?
179.translation_description: Uff! Questa settimana abbiamo superato noi stessi, vero, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

180.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_001
180.description: I can't wait to get back to Menphina's Arms and take a nice, long bath. Oh! And I mustn't forget the children's mealtime. Got that, Zhloe? Don't forget to feed the children... Don't forget to feed the children...
180.translation_description: Non vedo l’ora di tornare alle Braccia di Menphina e farmi un bel bagno. Oh! E non devo dimenticarmi di dar da mangiare ai bambini. Intesi, Zhloe? Non dimenticarti di dar da mangiare ai bambini...

181.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_003_002
181.description: Oh dear! Was I talking to myself again? Sorry about that. You take care of yourself, too! And don't forget to feed your children...er, if you have children. You don't have children, do you?
181.translation_description: Oh cielo! Stavo parlando di nuovo da sola? Scusa. Abbi cura di te anche tu! E non dimenticarti di dar da mangiare ai tuoi bambini... se ne hai, naturalmente. Non ne hai, vero?

182.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_000
182.description: Perfect! This should make a lovely addition to Zhloe's inventory.
182.translation_description: Perfetto! Sarà un’ottima aggiunta all’inventario di Zhloe.

183.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_001
183.description: I must say, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. I've never seen treasures quite so exquisite as those you've procured for me. Why, you might be the most crafter, gatherer, and fisherer that I've met since...well, ever! Wait, did I just say “fisherer?” That's not a word...is it?
183.translation_description: Devo dirti, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>: non ho mai visto tesori tanto raffinati quanto quelli che hai trovato. Potresti essere la persona più abile nel creare, raccogliere e... pescatorare che abbia mai incontrato! Aspetta, ho detto «pescatorare»? Non è una parola... vero?

184.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_004_002
184.description: Compared to that, my own skills as a trader leave something to be desired. But is Zhloe going to give up? Not on your life! The children are depending on me! Wait...did I forget to feed them <hex:02083BE3E90C0DFF1C020818E3E90C05FF07737570706572FF0A627265616B6661737403FF18020814E3E90C12FF066C756E6368FF077375707065720303> again?
184.translation_description: A confronto, le mie capacità di mercante lasciano un po’ a desiderare. Ma Zhloe si arrenderà? Neanche per sogno! I bambini contano su di me! Aspetta... mi sono dimenticata di dar loro da mangiare la <hex:020838E3E90C0DFF1A020816E3E90C05FF0563656E61FF0A636F6C617A696F6E6503FF17020813E3E90C12FF077072616E7A6FFF0563656E610303> di nuovo?

185.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_000
185.description: Thank you for another batch of lovely treasures, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!
185.translation_description: Grazie per un’altra fornitura di meravigliosi tesori, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>!

186.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_001
186.description: It's strange. Even though I'm doing the selling and you're doing the crafting, gathering, and, uh, fisherering, I feel like I've learned so much from you!
186.translation_description: È strano. Anche se sono io a vendere e tu ti occupi di artigianato, raccolta e... ehm, pescatoraggio, mi sembra di aver imparato tantissimo da te!

187.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_002
187.description: But there's still so, so much more to learn if I want to be half the trader that Rowena is. That's why I'm so happy that you've promised to keep helping me!
187.translation_description: Ma c’è ancora tantissimo da imparare, se voglio diventare almeno la metà della mercante che è Rowena. Per questo sono così felice che tu abbia promesso di continuare ad aiutarmi!

188.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_003
188.description: Wait, that wasn't just me talking to myself, right? This may come as a surprise, but I have a tendency to do that from time to time. You <hex:021A020203>did<hex:021A020103> promise, didn't you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?
188.translation_description: Aspetta, non stavo parlando da sola, vero? Forse ti sorprenderà, ma ogni tanto mi capita. Avevi <hex:021A020203>davvero<hex:021A020103> promesso, vero, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>?

192.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_010
192.description: Oh, thank you, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You're such a wonderful role model for me. I'll be watching you closer than ever to see just how I should carry and conduct myself!
192.translation_description: Oh, grazie, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Sei un esempio meraviglioso per me. Ti terrò d’occhio più che mai per imparare come dovrei comportarmi!

193.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_011
193.description: Wait! Don't move yet! I'm watching...watching...watching...still watching! Okay, that should do for now. Carry on!
193.translation_description: Aspetta! Non muoverti! Ti sto osservando... osservando... osservando! Va bene, per ora basta così. Puoi andare!

194.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_020
194.description: Wh-What!? Y-You're quitting? But why!? Could it be that Zhloe isn't as charming as she thought she was? Impossible! But how, then, to explain your completely inexplicable reaction?
194.translation_description: C-Cosa!? T-Ti ritiri? Ma perché!? Possibile che Zhloe non sia affascinante come credeva? Impossibile! E allora come si spiega una reazione tanto... inspiegabile?

195.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_005_021
195.description: ...But of <hex:021A020203>course<hex:021A020103>! You must be joking with me! Tee hee! That's the best joke I heard since Adkiragh told me I talk funny. How sweet you all are, always doing whatever you can to keep Zhloe's spirits high!
195.translation_description: ...Ma <hex:021A020203>certo<hex:021A020103>! Mi stai prendendo in giro! Eheh! È la battuta migliore che abbia sentito da quando Adkiragh mi ha detto che parlo in modo buffo. Siete tutti così gentili: fate sempre di tutto per tirare su il morale a Zhloe!

196.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_000
196.description: Thank you oh so much, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Just when I thought you'd done it all, you still manage to amaze me!
196.translation_description: Grazie di cuore, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Proprio quando pensavo che avessi già fatto tutto, riesci ancora a sorprendermi!

197.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_001
197.description: But to be honest, sometimes I worry. You've done so much for Zhloe, but what has Zhloe really done for you? I like working with you, but I wouldn't want you to waste your time unless <hex:021A020203>you<hex:021A020103> like working with me, too.
197.translation_description: Ma a essere sincera, a volte mi preoccupo. Hai fatto tantissimo per Zhloe, ma lei cosa ha fatto davvero per te? Mi piace lavorare con te, ma non vorrei che sprecassi il tuo tempo, a meno che non piaccia <hex:021A020203>a te<hex:021A020103> lavorare anche con me.

198.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_002
198.description: You can be honest with Zhloe. She's strong. She can take it. Has our little partnership been as fun and fruitful for you as it has for me?
198.translation_description: Puoi parlare liberamente con Zhloe. È forte, può sopportarlo. La nostra piccola collaborazione è stata divertente e fruttuosa per te quanto lo è stata per me?

199.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_003
199.description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! You have no idea how happy that makes me! I feel like I could soar high into the heavens on the wings of your words!
199.translation_description: Oh, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! Non hai idea di quanto mi renda felice! Mi sembra di poter volare fino al cielo sulle ali delle tue parole!

200.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_004
200.description: Why, I'm so happy I just might treat myself to a fresh bowl of pineapple pudding! Even better, a fresh pineapple! With the skin, leaves, and all!
200.translation_description: Sono così felice che potrei concedermi una scodella di budino all’ananas fresco! Anzi, meglio ancora: un ananas intero, con tanto di buccia e foglie!

202.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_A2_000_001
202.description: I don't think that's a good idea...
202.translation_description: Non credo sia una buona idea...

204.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_010
204.description: Heavens, what am I saying!? Forgive me, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Your gesture of admiration so moved me that I got ahead of myself for a moment there. It may surprise you to hear this, but I have a tendency to do that from time to time.
204.translation_description: Per gli dèi, che cosa sto dicendo!? Perdonami, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>. Il tuo gesto di stima mi ha commossa così tanto che per un attimo mi sono lasciata prendere la mano. Forse ti sorprenderà, ma ogni tanto mi capita.

205.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_RANKUP_ZHLOEALIAPOH_010_011
205.description: That's strange. You don't look particularly surprised. Anyhow, I look forward to a long and fruitful partnership for many moons to come!
205.translation_description: Che strano, non fai una piega. Comunque, spero che la nostra collaborazione continui a lungo e dia molti frutti, per molte lune a venire!

206.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_AFTWEEKLY_000_000
206.description: You have delivered the weekly maximum of six items to Zhloe. You may begin making deliveries again starting <hex:020603120303><hex:020942DDFF0753756E646179FF074D6F6E646179FF0854756573646179FF0A5765646E6573646179FF095468757273646179FF07467269646179FF09536174757264617903> at <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (Earth time).
206.translation_description: Hai consegnato a Zhloe il massimo settimanale di sei oggetti. Potrai ricominciare a effettuare consegne da <hex:020603120303><hex:020947DDFF09646F6D656E696361FF086C756E6564C3ACFF096D6172746564C3ACFF0B6D6572636F6C6564C3ACFF0967696F766564C3ACFF0976656E657264C3ACFF0773616261746F03> alle <hex:020821DBFF1D020919DB02030405060708090A0B0C0D02030405060708090A0B0C030D03> <hex:020810E0DB0DFF05702E6D2EFF05612E6D2E03> (ora terrestre).

207.name: TEXT_CTSSFSCHARACTER1_00386_DRESSUP_000_000
207.description: Furthermore, Zhloe Aliapoh's appearance may now be altered through the use of glamours.
207.translation_description: Ora puoi modificare l’aspetto di Zhloe Aliapoh applicandole un’illusione.
